season.evidence: Only 12 logged successful ascents (Jun 1, Jul 8, Aug 3); a NPS Olympus page names late June to mid-August for the same Blue Glacier approach; stored Jul-Sep, optimal Jul-Aug; keep Jul-Aug

otherTracksConsidered.why: 12 Jul 2025 summit, but part of a Bailey Range traverse that starts at Sol Duc, about 13 km from our Hoh trailhead pin; not a round trip on our approach
Logged White Glacier, 4 Aug 2012, summited, but the packet holds no GPS track (start/end null)

facts.text: After crossing the Blue Glacier in early August, a camp on the rocks about 200 ft below Panic Peak's summit puts you close to the climb, and it can be windy there.
On the ridge west of Olympus there are three bumps; in early August the correct notch was the one between the two right-hand bumps, and the other notch cost a party a backtrack.

notes: Only one ascent with a GPS track exists and it is a through-traverse, so no track assigned. The 2012 report's descent scramble into the White Glacier basin took a party of seven about three hours, consistent with our stored crux warning.
